## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the regression

- [ ] No secrets, private chat data, credentials, or local databases are included
- [ ] Privacy, authentication, tenant isolation, and migration impact were considered

## Screenshots
